The podcast is produced by Driftwood Outdoors.
More information about the podcast can be found at MissouriBiodiesel.org.

assumptions.text: The audience values information about biodiesel and sustainable energy initiatives.
Listeners trust organizations like the Biodiesel Coalition of Missouri as credible sources on biofuels.
Website domains ending in .org indicate trustworthy and authoritative sources.
Audience members have access to and use the internet to seek additional information.
